description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) tricks authenticated users into submitting forged requests to a target application by exploiting browser automatic cookie attachment. Detect via missing or predictable CSRF tokens in state-changing requests (POST/PUT/DELETE), absent `SameSite` cookie attributes, and JSON endpoints accepting `text/plain` Content-Type. Test using HTML auto-submitting forms, XHR requests, and CORS-enabled fetch. Tools: Burp Suite (Generate CSRF PoC), OWASP ZAP.
